narrative.details:
You bring excellent information, adventurer.

As Warchief, it is my duty to do what is best for the Horde. To ensure that the generations that come after us are not forced into a hopeless existence.

The opportunity to shape our future alliances has fallen into our collective laps. A move to help the dwarves could greatly strengthen our relationships in the Eastern Kingdoms. This, then, is why you must not fail!

Are you prepared?
narrative.objectives: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.
narrative.offerRewardText: There is no going back beyond this point, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 52 to 60, 41,000 XP in all.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron.

quests.name: Commander Gor'shak
quests.objectiveText: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping.

quests.name: The Eastern Kingdoms
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

quests.name: The Royal Rescue
quests.objectiveText: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.
